mapper.insert: insert into flow_area_minute(scenic_id, area_code, stat_minute, crowd_count) values(#{scenicId}, #{areaCode}, #{statMinute}, #{crowdCount}) on duplicate key update crowd_count=#{crowdCount}, updated_at=now()
mapper.select: select scenic_id, area_code, stat_minute, crowd_count from flow_area_minute where scenic_id=#{scenicId} and stat_minute between #{start} and #{end} order by stat_minute asc
